We need propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: likely 1) protect alcohol with TBS, 2) HWE (E-selective) to form double bond, 3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde, 4) TMSOTf protection maybe, 5) Still-Gennari (Z-alkene) etc. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse). So we need to break down target into precursors using templates.

We have a template for deprotection of TBS (broken TBS, formed OH). The search gave a template where product is alcohol, reactant is TBS-protected. So step 1 retrosynthesis: target (with OH) -> precursor with TBS protecting group. So we need to apply that template to target to get protected precursor.

We need to find template IDs. The result gave reaction_id 29646, template_hash etc. We need template_id (maybe reaction_id). Use get_template to retrieve details.
